messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: index out of bounds error
parts:
This is an error due to the newly released Rcpp.

I have released a hotfix release 2.1.1 just now.  Please reinstall rstan.  Hopefully it will be fine then.  

There is nothing but trying to fix the error in this release. 


Jiqiang 


On Sun, Feb 9, 2014 at 2:34 PM, Calvin Thigpen <cgth...@ucdavis.edu> wrote:
Bob,

Just wanted to chime in and let you know I'm having the same problems - I get:

"Error : index out of bounds
failed to create the sampler; sampling not done."

when I use the schools_code example in the Getting Started guide (https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/RStan-Getting-Started). I've tested the Rcpp package and it seems to be working just fine.

My machine and packages:

Mac OS X 10.9.1
64-bit R GUI 3.0.2
rstan 2.1.0
Rcpp 0.11.0 
inline 0.3.13 

Thanks for working on this issue.

Calvin


On Thursday, February 6, 2014 5:42:46 AM UTC-8, Bob Carpenter wrote:
We're still working on what's going wrong in the new Rcpp
and hope to have a patch out soon.

- Bob

On 2/6/14, 5:00 AM, mc96...@gmail.com wrote:
> I did find in my troubleshooting that one could still run the stan function help file examples, which don't have a data
> block, but changing the second example to where y was provided in a data block (with supplied data list) instead of
> transformed data resulted in the same error.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: index out of bounds error
parts:
On 2/9/14, 10:23 PM, Calvin Thigpen wrote:
> Perfect - all fixed. Thanks for the (incredibly fast) help!

Glad to hear it. And hats off to Jiqiang and Ben, who worked
very hard fixing the issue which was exposed with Rcpp 0.11.0.

It's very tricky tracking down issues that only arise intermittently
in some compilers on some platforms and then only through complex interfaces
like R to Rcpp to Stan.

- Bob

P.S. Search on the dev list for "rcpp 0.11.0" if you want to view
how the Stan sausages are made:

https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups#!forum/stan-dev

P.P.S. "like watching sausages getting made" is an English idiom:

http://www.usingenglish.com/reference/idioms/like+watching+sausage+getting+made.html

P.P.P.S. But apparently it was originally a German quotation:

http://www.brainyquote.com/quotes/quotes/o/ottovonbis161318.html

P.P.P.P.S. The web is so cool --- I'd never made the connection to "the gory details"
before:

http://english.stackexchange.com/questions/120739/a-peek-into-the-sausage-factory

http://www.ldoceonline.com/dictionary/gory
